method: Native in-app browser screenshots of actual encoded WebP: white, black and accepted city lawn; every asset at CSS viewports1024x768 and390x844. Visually inspected all7 tablet panels, both contact sheets and full phone panels for tree A and flowerbed B; all14 page loads and image sizes checked from DOM.
limitations: 52-degree camera and southwest light are artistic prompt cues, not a measured raster projection; compare in game.
No gameplay, occlusion, iPad/Safari FPS or PWA acceptance is implied by image QA.
Tree pivots use the lowest visible trunk/root band. Bush/flower anchors use silhouette bottom centre; actual botanical roots are hidden.
